external_data.description: External game directory for partner sites: games within a period, games by their Kogda-igra identifier, a single game card with its gamemasters and their specialities, or the list of projects with open registration. Changes nothing.

params.datestart: Period start in YYYY-MM-DD format; together with datefinish returns the games of that period
params.game_id: ID of the game in the allrpg.info calendar: return its card with gamemasters
params.open_list: Any non-empty value: return projects with open registration and an unfinished date
params.kogdaigra_id: ID of the game in the Kogda-igra directory: find the matching calendar games
